body:
## What it does

Flags each new episode as it lands and sends short notes written for someone building something, including the startup-idea angles rather than a transcript summary. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @buuxbt shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
